summary: The registrant, Fidelity Private Credit Co LLC, filed an 8-K to report entry into a Consent and Fifth Amendment to a Loan and Security Agreement. The amendment relates to a previously disclosed merger between Fidelity Private Credit Co LLC and Fidelity Private Credit Company II LLC, converting Tranche B commitments to revolving loans and reducing Tranche A commitments from $800M to $500M. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a standalone special situation. No price, premium, or activist details are present. The filing is a standard current report on material definitive agreements.
